title: Some users were unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel
impact: Some users were unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel because the Copilot pane was blank.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users aren't able to use Microsoft Copilot in Excel

User impact: Users aren't able to use or see Copilot in Excel.

More info: Specifically, impacted users report that when the Copilot in Excel side pane is opened, the panel is blank and the functionality is not usable.

Current status: We're reviewing service logs, recent changes introduced to the service, and contextual details provided by users who've encountered the issue to gain insight into the underlying source of impact and determine our next steps. 

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and some users attempting to use Copilot in Excel are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues. 

Next update by: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 5:00 AM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel

User impact: Some users may be unable to use or see Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel.

More info: Specifically, some users in the APAC region are experiencing an issue where the Copilot in Excel side pane appeared blank when opened, preventing them from using Copilot features.
 
Current status: We’re reviewing service telemetry to determine the root cause of the issue and evaluate the effectiveness of initial mitigation efforts. The investigation remains ongoing as we identify additional mitigation options to accelerate recovery.
 
Scope of impact: Some users in the APAC region attempting to use Copilot in Excel may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
 
Next update by: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 6:00 AM UTC

We've identified an update that caused the functionality to become unavailable. A rollback has been initiated, and we're closely monitoring recovery to ensure the experience is fully restored.

This quick update is designed to give the latest information on this issue.

As a workaround, affected users may be able to restore functionality more quickly by restarting the application or rebooting their device.

Title: Some users may be unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel

User impact: Some users may be unable to use or see Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel.

More info: Specifically, some users in the APAC region are experiencing an issue where the Copilot in Excel side pane appears blank when opened, preventing them from using Copilot features.

The affected users are able to restore functionality by restarting the application or rebooting their device.

Current status: The rollback of the affected update is continuing, and most of the previously impacted users are now experiencing recovery. Users who continue to encounter a blank Copilot pane can restore functionality by restarting Excel or rebooting their device. We're actively monitoring recovery throughout the affected region to verify that service functionality is fully restored.

Scope of impact: Some users in the APAC region attempting to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel may experience a blank Copilot pane and be unable to access Copilot functionality.
 
Start time: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
 
Preliminary root cause: We've identified that a component in a recent update is affecting the Copilot experience in the Excel desktop application, preventing users from accessing the Copilot pane.
   
Next update by: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users were unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel

User impact: Some users were unable to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel because the Copilot pane was blank.

More info: Some users in the Asia Pacific region experienced an issue in which the Microsoft 365 Copilot pane in Excel appeared blank when opened, preventing access to Copilot functionality.
 
The affected users could restore functionality by restarting the application or rebooting their device.
 
Final status: We've completed the rollback of the affected update and validated that the issue is resolved.
Users who continue to experience a blank Copilot pane can restore functionality by restarting Excel or rebooting their device.
 
Scope of impact: Some users in the APAC region attempting to use Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel may experience a blank Copilot pane and be unable to access Copilot functionality.

Start time: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
 
End time: Friday, August 21, 2026, at 12:20 PM UTC

Preliminary root cause: A recent update intended to improve the Microsoft 365 Copilot experience in the Excel desktop application prevented the Copilot pane from loading correctly for some users.
 
Next steps: We're reviewing our update validation and deployment processes to help prevent similar issues from occurring in future releases.
 
We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
